flags.detail: Nothing about this villa has been entered beyond its location and the existence of the photography. The brochure is published as a shell so the link is stable, and says on its face that it is not for circulation. It must not go to a buyer until the specification, price and title position are entered.

Palm Jumeirah is a designated freehold area, but that is a fact about the area, not proof of what this deed says. Read the title deed and check the DLD record for restrictions, mortgages and outstanding service charge before any tenure statement is made.

The supplied Drive folder has not been opened. Three checks are outstanding: that the frames show this villa, that no identifiable person appears without agreement, and that no frame shows the villa number, a gate plate or a neighbour's plate. The last one is a publication rule, not a preference.
Who holds the instruction, on what terms, and whether it is exclusive has not been recorded.
